text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone sure is running hard...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're not going to join?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well... I'm making new nail tips.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me your toenails got
worse...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, this is just, like... something my
trainer
told me to do.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to watch people run and
make nail
tips that express them or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's it? I mean, I'm cool with it,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the races ahead, Jordan is going to
need to
study her opponents carefully.
But meticulously
poring over race
footage might be a bit much at
first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'd like to start by developing
her
observation skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having her depict what she sees in some
form will
improve her perceptiveness.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Well, your trainer certainly thinks
outside
the box.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right? I never get told to just like,
study, which is
fine by me. Plus, I get
more nail tips. Win-win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, pretty sure what you're doing
counts as
studying, though... Anyway,
why don't you
"observe" me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... City's form is so cool... The way
she hits
the turf and...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! City is so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, she is an amazing runner. Just keeps going, unbothered by anything. Like... a straight line? And there's definitely glitter in there too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Jordan paints, I look into the
classic-year
runners she'll soon be up
against. I thought Triple
Crown
contenders would be the place to start,

but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the magazines are raving about the
star
rookies vying for the Tiara this year.
As for the
Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Five nail tips done. Pretty good,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mhm. Oh, that magazine...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Shes kind of a big deal, right? The girl
on the
cover. Everyone was fawning over
her on the
track the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But a whole special feature in a
magazine? She
must be something else. I
mean, people can't stop
talking about
the Tiara now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, it's like the Triple Crown
doesn't even
exist. Literally no one cares
this year.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, why? Does the Classic Triple
Crown not get
enough clicks or
something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, whatever. I don't get it. Back to
nail tips.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Everyone's still running. Go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, it's Palmer and Helios. Those
two haven't
gotten any slower.

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text:
Explooosion!
Demon speed! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... There go Leader Dum and
Leader Dee
of Arima fame...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's watching. That's
hilarious. I
better take a video.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are Palmer and Helios trying to
out-front-run
each other again? Wow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I wouldn't even mind if
someone
gapped me like that. It'd
actually be kinda cool.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer has like... two grand prix wins?
Arima
and... the other one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And Helios won some race twice in a row
or
something. City is amazing too, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone's getting so much attention.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone but me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going all out from the first
lap today!
Watch me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as training begins, Tosen Jordan
takes
off with a lot more vigor than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's also holding her head higher than
usual. It
reminds me of...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well? Did I get faster?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe because she experimented with
her form,
her time actually dropped a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The advantages?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer tends to hold her head
high, which
doesn't mesh well with
Jordan's style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Palmer's style is marked by the
fierceness to fight
till the end, even
when she's in the lead and the
only rival
around is herself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...It does?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Do you mean, like... wanting to win?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, but that's so vague. I need some
actual
strengths, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I just don't get it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's growing, whether she knows it or
not. That
she's able to pick up on other
styles and imitate
them is proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she takes the time to think and put
those
observations to use, she'll grow
even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training goes on as usual, until...

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! How is Tosen Jordan
doing?

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! She must really be improving,
then! Sounds
like we'll be seeing the
fruits of all that labor at
the Satsuki
Sho...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ack!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: M-my toenail... Ow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beads of sweat are forming on her face.
It looks
like she's in a lot of pain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as the ambulance arrives, we
carry her on
board and set off for the
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wee woo wee woo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her face only grows paler and paler
during the
ride.
